pattern: てばかりはいられない
purpose: Explain that one cannot keep doing only the current activity.
keywords: Vて + ばかりはいられない
We cannot keep grieving. Let us prepare for tomorrow.
I cannot spend all my time playing, so I will study this afternoon.
I cannot keep relying on others. I will investigate it myself too.
formation: Vて + ばかりはいられない
restrictions: Circumstances require moving on to another responsibility.
mistake: It is not simply a ban on the activity itself.
